repo_navigator/cli.py::main.purpose: Parse a repo-nav command, initialize optional templates, dispatch scanning or inspection, and return a command-line exit code.
side_effects: May create AGENTS.md and .ai/architecture.md during init
May regenerate .ai index files through scan
Reads repository source and index files through scan or inspect
Prints command results to stdout and handled errors to stderr

repo_navigator/indexer.py::read_json.purpose: Read a version-1 JSON object, returning a supplied default for a missing file or rejecting a missing/invalid index.
side_effects: Reads a UTF-8 JSON file from disk

repo_navigator/indexer.py::write_text_if.purpose: Atomically replace a UTF-8 text file only when its requested content differs from the current content.
side_effects: Creates parent directories as needed
Reads an existing destination file when present
Writes and atomically replaces the destination through a sibling temporary file

repo_navigator/indexer.py::write_json.purpose: Serialize a JSON object with stable indentation and a trailing newline, then write it only if changed.
side_effects: May create or atomically replace a JSON file and its parent directories

repo_navigator/indexer.py::semantic_stat.purpose: Classify a symbol's semantic entry as missing, stale, or verified from required fields and the current source hash.

repo_navigator/indexer.py::make_semantic.purpose: Build the current semantic-entry map, preserving entries for existing symbol IDs, adding blank entries, and dropping removed symbols.

repo_navigator/indexer.py::escape_cell.purpose: Convert a value to single-line Markdown table text and escape pipe characters.

repo_navigator/indexer.py::generate_mark.purpose: Render the file and symbol indexes with semantic purposes and review states as deterministic Markdown.

repo_navigator/indexer.py::scan.purpose: Collect current repository structure, reconcile semantic entries, generate Markdown, and persist the complete .ai index.
side_effects: Reads repository source files and existing semantics
May invoke Git during file discovery
Creates or updates .ai/files.json, .ai/symbols.json, .ai/semantics.json, and .ai/INDEX.md

repo_navigator/indexer.py::inspect.purpose: Compare current source structure, stored indexes, generated Markdown, and semantic review hashes without modifying them.
side_effects: Reads repository source and .ai index files
May invoke Git during file discovery

repo_navigator/scanner.py::digest.purpose: Return the SHA-256 hexadecimal digest of bytes or UTF-8 text.

repo_navigator/scanner.py::discover_file.purpose: Return sorted, supported, regular source files, using Git ignore rules at a repository root or a filtered directory walk otherwise.
side_effects: Runs Git discovery commands when Git is available
Traverses repository directories and inspects file metadata

repo_navigator/scanner.py::_git_availabl.purpose: Report whether a Git executable can be resolved from PATH.

repo_navigator/scanner.py::_python_symbo.purpose: Parse Python source and return structural records for functions and methods, including nested definitions and AST-based hashes.
Walk Python definition and top-level control-block nodes, appending function and method metadata to the enclosing extraction result.
side_effects: Appends discovered records to the enclosing symbols list

repo_navigator/scanner.py::_cpp_symbols.purpose: Parse C++ source with Tree-sitter and return structural records for function definitions with signature-qualified IDs.

repo_navigator/scanner.py::_cpp_symbols..purpose: Decode a Tree-sitter node's byte range from the enclosing C++ source.
Recursively find the first function_declarator node within a C++ declarator subtree.
Traverse C++ syntax scopes and append metadata for function definitions while excluding function-body descendants.
side_effects: Appends discovered records to the enclosing symbols list

repo_navigator/scanner.py::collect_struc.purpose: Read every discovered source file, extract language-specific symbols, validate unique IDs, and return deterministic file and symbol indexes.
side_effects: Reads discovered source files
May invoke Git during file discovery

tests/test_cpp.py::test_cpp_overloads_na.purpose: Verify C++ extraction distinguishes overload IDs and preserves namespace and class qualification.

tests/test_workflow.py::test_init_scan_r.purpose: Verify the init-to-review workflow, successful checking, stale detection, and preservation of prior semantics.
side_effects: Creates and modifies source and index files in pytest's temporary directory
Invokes CLI commands that write captured output

tests/test_workflow.py::test_existing_ag.purpose: Verify init preserves an existing AGENTS.md and indexes a Python class method correctly.
side_effects: Creates source, instruction, and index files in pytest's temporary directory
Invokes a CLI command that writes captured output

tests/test_workflow.py::test_nested_func.purpose: Verify nested Python functions are indexed and unchanged AST hashes survive leading line shifts.
side_effects: Creates and modifies source and index files in pytest's temporary directory
Invokes CLI commands that write captured output

tests/test_workflow.py::test_ignored_dir.purpose: Verify fallback scanning excludes source files under ignored build directories.
side_effects: Creates source, build, and index files in pytest's temporary directory
Invokes a CLI command that writes captured output

tests/test_workflow.py::test_invalid_pyt.purpose: Verify a Python parse failure returns an error without replacing the last valid symbol index.
side_effects: Creates and modifies source and index files in pytest's temporary directory
Invokes CLI commands that write captured output

tests/test_workflow.py::test_removed_sym.purpose: Verify rescanning removes semantics for a deleted symbol and leaves the empty repository checkable.
side_effects: Creates and modifies source and index files in pytest's temporary directory
Invokes CLI commands that write captured output
